verdict.pick: We Feed Raw Premium Raw Dog Food
verdict.line: Picture a senior dog who loves a hearty, minimally processed meal. We Feed Raw offers nutrient‑dense, USDA‑standard ingredients that keep dogs healthy and satisfied. It outperforms other raw/fresh picks by being the only brand tested that won on both nutrition and taste.
